crossRefs.note: For I know that you will bring me to death, To the house appointed for all living.
You will eat bread by the sweat of your face until you return to the ground, for you were taken out of it. For you are…
You turn man to destruction, saying, “Return, you children of men.”
and the dust returns to the earth as it was, and the spirit returns to God who gave it.
Wrath is not in me, but if I should find briers and thorns, I would do battle! I would march on them and I would burn…
For I will not contend forever, neither will I always be angry; for the spirit would faint before me, and the souls…

translations.web: all flesh would perish together, and man would turn again to dust.
translations.bsb: all flesh would perish together and mankind would return to the dust.
translations.kjv: All flesh shall perish together, and man shall turn again unto dust.
translations.asv: All flesh shall perish together, And man shall turn again unto dust.
